| [SYNTHESIS-017](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-017.md) v2 | What a record of a developing argument can secure is traceable change over its accountability structure, which is neither sufficiency for revision nor correctness: current conclusions and support topology do not fix revisions, a sufficient state makes history redundant only while its model and decisions hold, and what kept justifications can buy is a wider family of decisions and decisions a bounded agent could not otherwise make |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-040](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-040.md) | A system's budgeted individuation is indexed by two budgets that run in opposite directions, observing splitting what can be told apart and acting under peak costs merging what can be turned into one another, so the two partitions agree only on levels common to both chains, which the order of probe costs decides; which category and enrichment is chosen fixes what counts as the same, and neither isomorphism nor a profile settles persistence |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-050](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-050.md) | Conferral among an organization's processes is any effect on another's share of future influence, and a grant is conferral through a maintained relation; how grants are counted and scored decides whether authority tracks reliability or entrenches: an accounting rule can keep an operator's authority independent of its own grants, trust can be the regularity of grants earned by being right, and when authority is scored against the interpretation it helped make dominant the same loop can amplify an initial advantage without fidelity, which in the linear model only the two-way coupling starts and independent scoring removes; capture runs through the evidence an evaluation receives or the criteria it weighs by, with different remedies, and the standard that would tell capture from merited trust is not supplied |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-052](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-052.md) | What a collective is credited with need not be what its members hold: an organized whole's operative intention is not the expectation of its members' intentions and its reasons can part from theirs; a diffuse population with no procedure can show a public stance or change an outside institution without a collective intention, whether the credit is then due to it is open, and composition and a group process are offered as routes by which its most committed or extreme members fix the stance; a person can be organized by a judgement attributed to a collective that does not hold it, governs themselves by making such a judgement's authority depend on its grounds, and that rule holds without qualification only for judgements of what already is; and whether a community of sound inquirers can settle on a belief none of them reasoned to is open, with model results whose tests in real communities are open questions | A part account of the distributed-agency line: the part on what is credited to a collective as against what its members hold. The third asks whether a community of sound inquirers can settle on a belief none of them reasoned to ([QUESTION-047](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-047.md)), with five questions that hold the real-world tests of its model readings. | [SYNTHESIS-056](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-056.md) v2 | An organizational perspective is not thereby an agent, and what an organization can see, take up and correct are separate achievements that its success and coherence do not show: a description adequate for the whole can merge what its members' claims distinguish, which distinctions must be legible is relative to a task and to a policy, an arrangement of institutions can keep its effectiveness while its correctability degrades, and the wrong of reproducing what keeps a justified standard from constraining an organization is proposed as a breach of a bounded duty of answerability |  | Proposed |
